name: Isekai Healing Life
source:
The protagonist is hit by a truck and transported to another world.
Sold as a servant, he struggles to survive in this strange land with the help of two lovable catgirl sisters.

[From [url=https://team-sh.itch.io/isekai-healinglife]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主角被卡车撞到了异世界。
他被卖为仆人，在两个可爱的猫女姐妹的帮助下，在这片陌生的土地上挣扎着生存。

[来自[url=https://team-sh.itch.io/isekai-healinglife]itch.io[/url]]
